name: Signed-in user can change password from Settings
description: Open tenant Settings (Profile settings), confirm a Your password card is visible with current, new, and confirm fields plus Update password. Submit with mismatched new passwords and confirm the form stays on the page without crashing. Do not complete a real password change.

planSteps.description: Sign in if needed, then go to /settings (Profile settings from the account menu).
A Your password card is visible with Current password, New password, Confirm new password, and Update password.
Enter any current password, a new password of at least 8 characters, and a different confirm password, then click Update password.
The page stays on Settings, shows a mismatch or failure message, and does not sign the user out or crash.
